Harpreet Desai
Senior Frontend Engineer | Mumbai
harpreet.desai620@example.com | +91 9293789519

Senior frontend engineer focused on deliverable-driven user interfaces and maintainable component systems. Strong collaborator across design and backend teams to ship performant, accessible web applications. Available with a 60 days notice period.

Experience
Wipro, Feb 2024 - Present
Senior Frontend Engineer — Remote
- Led development of a customer-facing portal component library using TypeScript and CSS, reducing new page build time by 35% and improving consistency across 12 applications; implemented Redux patterns for predictable state and simplified debugging.
- Introduced TypeScript strict mode across three major web projects, catching integration errors early and decreasing runtime defects by 22% in the first quarter.
- Wrote unit and integration tests with Jest for critical flows, raising test coverage from 48% to 78% on a key product and preventing regressions during two major releases.
- Collaborated in Agile ceremonies via Jira and Confluence, driving sprint planning and grooming that improved sprint predictability and delivery rate.

Paystack India, Oct 2017 - Jan 2024
Frontend Engineer — On-site
- Built and maintained high-throughput payment UI components in React and TypeScript that handled peak traffic spikes, contributing to a 15% improvement in checkout conversion.
- Implemented Redux-based state management for transaction flows, simplifying retry logic and reducing edge-case failures by 18%.
- Developed reusable CSS modules and responsive layouts, cutting frontend bundle size by 12% and improving Lighthouse performance metrics across key pages.
- Authored Jest test suites for payment integrations and user journeys, integrated tests into CI to catch regressions; documented flows and runbooks in Confluence and tracked work with Jira.

Projects
- Component Accessibility Audit: Conducted an accessibility and performance audit of a legacy React UI, remediated issues, and raised automated test coverage with Jest to ensure ongoing compliance.
- Internal Style Guide: Led creation of an internal style guide documented in Confluence that standardized CSS patterns and TypeScript types for shared components.
